## Workload

During the quarter, Hannah Lowe completed 192 reads over 243 hours. This represents a rate of 0.8 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review alongside the associated quality check, providing a basis for considering whether the current session pattern remained appropriate. Following discussion of the workload and the review findings, the grader and reviewer agreed to keep the current session pattern.

## Quality

A sample of 15 reads was checked again. Agreement between the original grading and the review was 66.7 per cent. The result was considered alongside the workload information rather than in isolation. No change to the current session pattern was recommended on the basis of this review.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
